worlds.name: The Sun
worlds.hook: The Sun is a giant ball of glowing gas. It holds 99.8% of everything in the solar system!

worlds.name: Mercury
worlds.hook: Mercury is the smallest planet. One trip around the Sun takes just 88 days!

worlds.name: Venus
worlds.hook: Venus is the hottest planet, over 460 degrees C. It also spins backward!

worlds.name: Earth
worlds.hook: Earth is the only place we know that has life. It has 1 moon.

worlds.name: The Moon
worlds.hook: On the Moon you weigh about 1/6 as much. Get ready for giant jumps!

worlds.name: Mars
worlds.hook: Mars is red because of rusty iron dust. It has Olympus Mons, the biggest volcano in the whole solar system!

worlds.name: Jupiter
worlds.hook: Jupiter is the biggest planet. Its Great Red Spot is a storm bigger than Earth!

worlds.name: Saturn
worlds.hook: Saturn has shiny rings. It is so light that it could float in a giant bathtub!

worlds.name: Uranus
worlds.hook: Uranus spins on its side, like a ball rolling around the Sun!

worlds.name: Neptune
worlds.hook: Neptune is the windiest planet. Its winds blow at over 2,000 km/h!
